# PowerPoint preview regression fixture

`indexed-preview.png` is a real indexed-color PNG exported by desktop PowerPoint from
the synthetic two-slide Quarterly Results deck generated by
`backend/tests/support/powerpoint.py`. It contains only invented test text. The Office
smoke in `tests/integration/smoke_powerpoint_analysis.py` reproduces the export.

This covers the real export encoding that explicit-format `QImage.fromData` rejected
on the tested PySide6 build. The review decoder uses bounded `QImageReader` inspection
and checks the decoded dimensions. This is a test fixture, not fabricated live evidence.
